intro: Ulag the Cleaver is a rite of passage for young Forsaken warriors in Tirisfal Glades. Deathguard Dillinger tasks you with releasing and executing an enslaved Scourge warrior bound inside a northern mausoleum, testing your martial resolve and earning the respect of the Deathguard.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When the Scourge swept through Tirisfal Glades, we captured one to study. He had a free mind, and called himself Ulag the Cleaver. But, although his will was free, he was still enthralled by the Lich King.
We hoped to find a way to break the king's control over Ulag, but we failed. Now, finally, it is time to free him.
Activate the skull stone trigger near the mausoleum to the north. This will lift the magical seal that binds him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Your task is yet undone, friend. It is not wise for a warrior to show fear...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. Ulag was no minor agent of the Scourge. You have shown the Deathguards, and hence the Dark Lady, that you are a warrior of skill and resolve, and are worthy of further instruction.
